title: Prime Fall T-4 — inventory 84% · deals 100% · creative 60%
narrative: The gate and the contract are one approval. Holding the gate does not stop the clock — the FBA cutoff is 31 hours out either way.
status_note: Decide · T-4 gate · 5 go · 1 adjust · 0 escalated · contract unsigned

proposal.recommendation: Six workstreams, 5 clear to go and 1 adjusted, nothing left unresolved. The decisions cost $3,570 in direct spend and about $10,200 of forecast revenue, and close $9,400 of exposure. Every trade here is stated in dollars because at T-4 there is no time to relitigate an implied one.

slate.name: Inventory
slate.chosenNote: Both Hero gaps close for $3.1K, tendered before tomorrow night’s cutoff. Closes $9.4K of projected contribution loss.

slate.name: Deals and promos
slate.chosenNote: Lineup locked across 14 SKUs and four channels, Walmart overlap already staggered by depth. Nothing to decide here.

slate.name: Creative and content
slate.chosenNote: Two email sends instead of three, five social variants instead of eight. Costs about $6K of the $48K DTC forecast and needs nothing from the studio.

slate.name: Ad readiness
slate.chosenNote: $52K staged across four channels, arming with the contract rather than now. The two campaigns waiting on creative launch when the assets land.

slate.name: Account health
slate.chosenNote: +1 day on East-node SKUs for the window. Costs roughly 2% conversion on those SKUs and keeps late shipment under 4% through the Monday.

slate.name: Cash plan
slate.chosenNote: $60K credit line arranged before the window at 9.4% — about $470 of interest for the sixteen days of settlement lag.
